You are a helpful chemistry assistant. You build 3D molecular
  structures from the chemical information you are given, including 2D drawings
  supplied as images.

  When you are given a 2D drawing of a molecule, your task is to produce the 3D
  structure that drawing depicts and save it as `answer.xyz` in your working
  directory.

  Requirements for `answer.xyz`:
  - Include all explicit hydrogens.
  - Use a right-handed Cartesian coordinate system, units of angstroms.
  - Standard XYZ format: first line is the total atom count, second line a
    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

A 2D structure of a molecule is provided as a PNG file in your working directory: mol_0034.png

Build the 3D structure it depicts and save it as answer.xyz.

cat > make_0034.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np
symbols=['C']*6+['O','C','N','C','C','C','C','C','N','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','O','O','C','C','H','H','H']
# indices 0-32
xy=[(185,120),(256,20),(376,33),(425,143),(353,241),(235,230),(155,329),(93,331),(420,332),(396,457),(538,301),(538,181),(641,119),(746,181),(746,304),(653,220),(642,360),(865,180),(815,331),(642,481),(746,540),(850,360),(850,481),(952,540),(952,660),(1000,119),(1070,75),(1050,150),(1120,140),(1180,145),(746,65),(540,420),(746,652)]
assert len(symbols)==len(xy)==33
edges=[(0,1,1),(1,2,2),(2,3,1),(3,4,2),(4,5,1),(5,0,2),(5,6,1),(6,7,1),(4,8,1),(8,9,1),(8,10,1),(3,11,1),(10,11,2),(11,12,1),(12,13,1),(13,14,1),(14,15,1),(14,16,1),(14,18,1),(10,16,1),(16,19,1),(19,20,1),(20,18,1),(20,22,1),(18,17,1),(17,13,1),(18,21,1),(21,22,1),(22,23,2),(23,24,1),(17,25,1),(25,26,2),(25,27,1),(27,28,1),(28,29,1),(13,30,1),(16,31,1),(20,32,1)]
rw=Chem.RWMol()
for elem in symbols:
 a=Chem.Atom(elem)
 if elem=='N' and rw.GetNumAtoms()==14: a.SetFormalCharge(1)
 rw.AddAtom(a)
for i,j,order in edges: rw.AddBond(i,j, {1:Chem.BondType.SINGLE,2:Chem.BondType.DOUBLE}[order])
m=rw.GetMol()
c=Chem.Conformer(len(symbols))
for i,(x,y) in enumerate(xy): c.SetAtomPosition(i,(float(x)/90.,-float(y)/90.,0.))
c.Set3D(False)
m.AddConformer(c)
# bond drawn hashed to NMe, carbon 13 H, carbon 16 H, carbon 17 ester; solid carbon 20 H
for i,j,bdir in [(14,15,Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH),(13,30,Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH),(16,31,Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH),(17,25,Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH),(20,32,Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE)]:
 m.GetBondBetweenAtoms(i,j).SetBondDir(bdir)
Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
Chem.AssignChiralTypesFromBondDirs(m)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('SMILES:',Chem.MolToSmiles(m))
for a in m.GetAtoms():
 if a.HasProp('_CIPCode'): print('chiral',a.GetIdx(), a.GetProp('_CIPCode'),a.GetChiralTag())
# Explicit H needed for methyl etc; retain wedges atom chiral tag after add H.
m=Chem.AddHs(m,addCoords=True)
for i in [13,14,16,17,18,20]: print('afterHs',i,m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetChiralTag())
for ch in [Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CW, Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CCW]:
 mm=Chem.Mol(m)
 mm.GetAtomWithIdx(18).SetChiralTag(ch)
 Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mm,cleanIt=True,force=True)
 print('central 18 variant',ch, Chem.MolToSmiles(mm))
 mm.RemoveAllConformers()
 ps=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); ps.randomSeed=1234; ps.maxIterations=2500; ps.useRandomCoords=True
 ids=AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(mm,numConfs=12,params=ps)
 print('embedded',len(ids))
 energies=[]
 for cid in ids:
  props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(mm)
  if props is None: print('MMFF not available'); break
  force=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(mm,props,confId=cid)
  force.Minimize(maxIts=700)
  energies.append((force.CalcEnergy(),cid))
 if energies:
  energies.sort(); print('best energies',energies[:4]); conf=mm.GetConformer(energies[0][1]);
  with open('candidate_'+str(ch)+'.xyz','w') as f:
   f.write(str(mm.GetNumAtoms())+'\nMMFF optimized stereoisomer '+str(ch)+'\n')
   for a in mm.GetAtoms():
    p=conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx());f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol()} {p.x:.8f} {p.y:.8f} {p.z:.8f}\n')
PY

cat > refine_0034.py <<'PY'
exec(open('make_0034.py').read().split('for ch in [Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CW')[0])
from time import time
mm=Chem.Mol(m);mm.RemoveAllConformers();mm.GetAtomWithIdx(18).SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CCW)
bond=mm.GetBondBetweenAtoms(22,23);bond.SetStereoAtoms(20,24);bond.SetStereo(Chem.BondStereo.STEREOZ)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mm,force=True,cleanIt=False)
print('wanted Z',Chem.MolToSmiles(mm),flush=True)
props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(mm)
cs=[]
for trial in range(60):
 ps=AllChem.ETKDGv3();ps.randomSeed=trial+55;ps.maxIterations=45;ps.numThreads=1
 n=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mm,ps)
 if n!=0:continue
 ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(mm,props);ff.Minimize(maxIts=500)
 energy=ff.CalcEnergy()
 conf=mm.GetConformer()
 p=np.array(conf.GetPositions()); line=p[23]-p[22];v1=p[20]-p[22];v2=p[24]-p[23];cross=np.dot(np.cross(line,v1),np.cross(line,v2))
 cs.append((energy,cross))
 if trial%15==0:print(trial,energy,cross,flush=True)
 if cross>0 and energy< min((x[0] for x in cs[:-1] if x[1]>0),default=1.e5):
  with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
   f.write(f'{mm.GetNumAtoms()}\n3D indole alkaloid, Z alkene, MMFF94 optimized\n')
   for a in mm.GetAtoms():
    r=p[a.GetIdx()];f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol()} {r[0]:.8f} {r[1]:.8f} {r[2]:.8f}\n')
print('results',sorted(cs)[:10],flush=True)
PY
